dedupe_keys.name: harmonized household electricity data and knowledge graph

description: The Jozef Stefan Institute publishes harmonized household electricity observations with a knowledge graph that connects consumption series to their source metadata. Coverage combines studies from several countries and periods, not one continuous monitoring campaign. Figshare provides RDF triples, metadata and harmonized-data archives, plus a REDD example; the project also exposes an archive index and a public SPARQL query interface. The deposit is free under CC BY 4.0, with original source licences requiring separate attention. These records can support appliance-use inference, demand forecasting and calibration of residential energy simulations using model-energyplus. A caveat is that sampling rates, household selection and appliance labels differ between contributing studies. Harmonization does not remove those differences. Large archives and Python-specific serialization add preparation costs; their contents were not downloaded or benchmarked.
